body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> PENTAX presented a compact 7.1M digital camera ‘Optio E30’ at CES 2007. It features a 2.5 LCD screen, x3 optical zoom, and 11MB of built-in memory. Powered by two alkaline batteries, the Optio E30 can take up to approximately 200 photos.
